description: Audio models stop depending on a side effect. mlx-audio 0.4.3's [all] extras happened to carry the Kokoro stack (spacy, misaki, librosa, phonemizer-fork, espeakng-loader, num2words, numba, pyloudnorm, wsproto); 0.6.3 carries none of it and upstream moved those into omlx's optional `audio` extra, which the Homebrew install step never asks for. Building the tap then died on its own `import spacy` check, and text-to-speech models would have failed at the first request even if it had passed. The dev tree lists them as base dependencies, because this board serves audio. Upstream already knows: jundot/omlx issue #3916 (open, 2026-09-25) and PR #4371 (open, 2026-10-08) ask for exactly this - bump the resource, drop the inreplace, install the audio extra, and add a formula/pyproject drift guard. Today's commit 3a5a6b2 took the first two and left the third out, which is what broke the build. This is a vendored dev-tree workaround for that open PR, not a fork of upstream intent; drop it when the PR merges or when the formula installs .[grammar,audio].
